hook: *1,000 delegates* from 70 countries head to Hitex from Nov 12
hook_b: *1,000 delegates* from 70 countries head to Hitex from Nov 12
tldr: Congress hosts the Bharat Summit at Hitex, Hyderabad, from Nov 12 to 14, the second time the city hosts it.

beats.what: Talks cover a new global order, cooperative federalism and electoral integrity, plus a new think tank 'Our World'.
beats.why: Telangana passed the Platform Based Gig Workers Bill, 2026 in March, which prompted the gig workers meet.
beats.care: Expect VIP movement around Hitex and HITEC City roads on Nov 13 or 14.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI: Rahul Gandhi will come on either Nov 13 or 14, TPCC chief Mahesh Kumar Goud said.

cards.q: Do big summits at Hitex affect your commute?

qs: What does the Gig Workers Act change for delivery and ride-hailing workers in Hyderabad?

facts.t: This is the *second time* Hyderabad hosts the Bharat Summit.

viz.verdict: Three days of events at Hitex
